steps.name: Elixir of Mind (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Elliot] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Romalius] in “Invernell Safe Zone.”

lines.text: (While looking around the village, the image of a boy staring endlessly at the lakeside comes into view.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Um… . What should I do... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, what were you doing?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah… . Well, I was just looking at the lake and thinking about what to do... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: That… , that is… I don't know if I can tell you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Glinda's orders, no... . I have some homework to do as a suggestion... . If you don't do it, you'll get scolded... … .
(Elliot's face turns pale.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I help you?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Are you serious? Thank you… . Thank goodness… … .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Glinda is a witch... . He looked at my condition recently and said he would make an elixir for my heart... … .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: If only I had that medicine, my heart would become stronger... They said it could be done... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An elixir for the mind?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Since I was young, I was timid, tearful, and weak, so I wanted to change my personality... … .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I tried a lot... It didn't work out... . In the end, I found a ridiculous way, and that was to meet a witch and make a wish... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: After hearing that a witch had appeared near Glaston, I wandered around and met the real witch, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … … Ah, it’s a long story… . If you talk to me later when you have time, I will tell you separately... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elliot, I think you speak better than me...)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I found all the ingredients, but I couldn't find a few... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Where do you get something like this? .
(Elliot bows his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. First, I want to see what the ingredients are.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: W, here… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ominous horn of a high-ranking demon, the purified horn? This is why Elliot couldn't save him.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But can this be used as an ingredient in medicine?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'm not sure... . That's something only the witch Glinda knows... … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you get all these things? Cat beastman's hair, rotten tree roots, frog eggs, spirit tears, demon beast Nav's eyes... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… . I got most of it from the village. ah… , I went and brought only the demonic beast’s eyes… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: When the demon beast Nav is sleeping, it takes its eyes off and sticks them somewhere for a moment... . I took advantage of that moment and quickly grabbed it and ran away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t think you can do that unless you have the courage to do so.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Well, I did something like that... I want to change my timid personality... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elliot is sincere...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will learn more about demon horns. There are demons that have faces.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes? Eh, eeh!! Ah, a demon with a face?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, those are the demons who came out of the demon world and converted. Should I say that he is a good person recognized by Demigod Lydia?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Well, if it's a demon recognized by Demigod... Well, it's okay, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I'm going to go and ask.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you... . Black… .
(Elliot wipes away the tears from his eyes and smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I… , %s. Uh, where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Invernell.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Try this once... . This was given to me by Glinda... . If you eat it, you can ride the wind and get to the place you wanted with the help of the wind spirit... .
(Elliot hands %s a small piece of candy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Candy?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … I also had it once... … It was okay. There was no stomach upset or anything. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will trust Elliot and try it.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, now, just a moment… .
Gulp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? uh? uh? Uhhhh?!
(The moment the candy goes down Adventurer's throat, a gust of wind arises from the direction of the lake and flies toward Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah!
(The wind picks up Adventurer and blows it somewhere without giving Elliot a chance to talk.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … … I was going to tell you that the wind was stronger than I thought... … .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Uh… what?
(Elliot senses that he is being watched and turns around.)
Uh, can you see me? lol.
(A girl with long black hair scratches her head and purple horns.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Is it because of my mood... . I think there was something… .
Thank goodness. I can't see this sister! If he had seen me, he would have scolded me.
I'm tired of waiting, so let's follow along. Oh, I guess I should contact you in advance. It's annoying... . no way… .
(The girl places two fingers on her head and closes her eyes.)
“Tip, I am Tippeta. I think it will be easier to get horns than you think. “I’m going to leave Dorothy’s village for a moment.”
(When the girl, who called herself Tippeta, takes her hand away from her head, the small wings on her back spread out with all their might.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Where is Invernell? Ah, the old Highlands.
(Tiphetta, after muttering to herself, flies up into the sky and disappears into the clouds.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … iced coffee… . Well, what Glinda said was correct... .

steps.name: Flask of Mind (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Romalius] in “Invernell Safe Zone” and report the quest to [Little Bluebird] in “Bayuna Canyon”.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Do you come to your senses?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: This is my first time seeing this face, so why was it hanging on the bell tower of the temple? I had a bit of trouble putting it down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, this is %s. You know?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Uh… .
(Romalius rubs his eyes and looks at %s's face again.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Someone said it and it was you. How did you fly there without wings?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have some work to do.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I see. Then, take care of your business and then go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you busy right now? I'm here because I have something to ask Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: As soon as my part-time job ends, I have some free time until I start another part-time job. But what happened? Is this a new job?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I needed ingredients to make something.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Looking at the ingredients, it looks like you need a demon horn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I don't know if it's because the horns of demonic beasts and demons have powerful magical power, but there are surprisingly many places where they are needed.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You can make it into a magic tool, make it into medicine, eat it, or use it as an ornament.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow I feel like I have nothing to throw away... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It would be great if it was used for good, but there are many cases where it is not... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So the horn you need has been purified? Hasn't it been purified? I think I can talk about it only if I know its use.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both. Where do you need it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain why Romalius needs horns.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh… . So does that mean you can do good deeds? Ingredients for medicine for boys who lack courage. This is lucky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it goes. Uh, Romalius. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Wait a minute.
(Romalius walks quickly into the temple and comes out holding something black.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Now, here.
(Romalius puts the broken horn piece into %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know that Lydia took the broken horn... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Not long ago, the church said they would return it because they no longer need it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was thinking about what to do with something that was useless, so I buried it in the ground without even thinking about it, but when I looked in the morning, it had grown.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: To borrow the words of parrot reporter Daniel, the horns of demons grow like this in special cases!

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So I cut it into small pieces and sell it as a souvenir. It is a piece of horn from a high-ranking demon certified by the church and purified by the Demigod.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Although it doesn't have any magic power, it is still popular because it can be used in various places.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If I do this, someday I will be able to live in a decent house.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I just give it away like this while saving money to buy a house?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's okay. Helping you is helping the goddess. If you talk to the church, they will raise your part-time hourly wage, which is good.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If you lose it, come back to me. I'll give you the same thing. So that's enough now, right? Oh, I guess I'll need some unpurified horns too... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Have you ever met my brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Andrea… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I don't really want to mention it, and you probably don't want to see me again either, but... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Go and say my name and ask for the horn in exchange for the debt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you really want to give it to me then?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Just trust what the good demons say. I want to go myself, but I'm afraid Andrea will kill me as soon as I go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's like a typical fight between brothers.
(Romalius laughs lightly and taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'll stop then. It's time for a part-time job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If you really appreciate it, please introduce me to a high-paying part-time job later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go to Bayuna Canyon. Before entering the gate of Lysithea, I also saw Sylphid... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Ah, %s. There's something I didn't say before... . You're gone.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even though it doesn't make money, why not do something kind?

steps.name: Flask of Mind (3)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Little Blue Bird] in 「Bayuna Canyon」, enter 「Gate of Lysithea」, defeat [Andrea], and obtain <Ominous Horn of High-ranking Demon>. 
2. Go to the reward room and talk to [Andrea], then return to “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Elliot].

lines.speaker: 작은 파랑새
lines.text: Sting. Sting.
(As the little blue bird flaps its wings, the dust surrounding it disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 작은 파랑새
lines.text: Oh, this should be enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphide, you are here.
(A small blue bird called a sylphid steps back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. A person I met for the first time was staring at me, so I disguised myself as a bird... , I never thought it would be you.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. How did you do it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He briefly talks about the fact that he has been living in Dorothy's village since breaking up with Silphid.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It's fascinating. There was such a thing as an effect of the medicine made by the witch. Moreover, the relationship between the witch and Iris is the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found it fascinating too. Is the canyon okay now?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. There was no big problem. Silpin helped me a lot, so even if something like a gate to the demon world appeared, I was able to quickly get rid of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. But since then, I haven’t heard Iris’s voice.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Perhaps you are looking for a way. I'm a little worried that my voice isn't reaching me, but let's just trust the goddess and wait.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Are you going to go through that door now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. As I said, Dorothy Village needs something... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I don't know if the demon inside the door will obediently give me the horn. It is always forbidden to let down your guard.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. If you go in and something dangerous happens or you think you need my help, yell at me to stab.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It doesn’t have to be now, so you can do it later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, sting. I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. See you later then. I'm going to go punish the bad guy.
(Sylphid waves its small wings in greeting and takes off powerfully.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Please come back. Should I go now too… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, but the bad guy… . Who are you talking about?
(Adventurer still looks around the room, seeing nothing except many doors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought I would come here again. Where to find Andrea?
(As Adventurer felt something, he hurriedly retreated, and an arrow flew from somewhere and hit the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, where are you?
(A man with red horns slowly walks out through the small door at the end.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I never thought you would find your way here again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He was alive.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Yes, he was alive. Because I have to do something to survive. By the way, did you come all the way here to make sure your life is still alive?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You know what it means to come in here... .
(Andrea lifts the bowstring and aims at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I was careless back then, but today my bow will pierce your heart... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm here to tell you what Romalius said.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What?
(Andrea lowers her bow at the word Romalius.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What did he say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea said he owed me money and told me to take it for him.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You sure didn't ask me to take my broken horn, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I need the broken horn of a high-ranking demon.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Unlucky guy. Think only of yourself until the end. Lux gave my broken horn to a human... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Yes, useless horns. I'll give it to you. Instead, you'll have to make me happy.
(With those words, Andrea jumps up to the high door and disappears in an instant through the gap in the door.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't think they would just give it to me, but... . I can't help it. let's go.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: … Stop it.
(After receiving an attack from %s, Andrea steps back and puts away her weapon. Then, she takes out the broken horn from her arms and throws it at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I give it to you like this?
(Adventurer takes the red horn and looks at Andrea.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I've confirmed that you have the ability to accept the debt, so all I can do is give it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Otherwise, I might not have been able to receive it... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If Romalius had come in person, things would have been different... . I'm glad I don't have any debt anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Saying thank you to someone you tried to kill... . That's funny.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: The exit is the door on the left. Be careful as you may lose your footing when leaving... . Wait you… .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You met Lux. I can smell Lux's bad smell on you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I knew Lux was out of the demon world and up to something, but I didn't expect you to meet her. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: How did you meet Lux?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no reason to tell you that.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You might get some good information from me, but are you going to take that stance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will listen first and then judge.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Hehe, it doesn't matter since I'm trapped anyway. Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: The Lux over there is not a proper Lux. He removed a part of himself from the demon world and sent it to the human world.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I was told that I would complete the Remegeton or something, and that once I got that, everything would be over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lemegeton? What do you want?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I don't even know what that is. Would I be here if I knew what it was? I guess I killed Lux ​​and took it.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Isn't it obvious that Lux, who has acquired almost everything in the Demon World, wants something more? To become a god.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Looking at their expressions, it seems like something big happened between them. Then just answer one question. Lux's actions had something to do with God, right?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: And you, a man of the goddess, would have prevented it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It's going to be fun.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Now go back. Your presence on the Hellfire Walk will be a disruption.
(Andrea laughs and opens a nearby door and goes in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I learned something new about Lux, but something feels off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, now that we've got everything we need, let's go back to the village.

steps.name: Flask of Mind (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Elliot] in “Dorothy Village” and go to [Runo]. And after the conversation, report the quest to [Runo].

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: That's up there in the sky, right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Just do what the boss says and act casually. I'll take care of the rest.
(Luno taps Elliot on the shoulder and walks away from the village towards the rising lake water.)
(After a while, Tippeta, who was flying in the sky, slows down and lands on top of the building.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Ugh, this sucks. bothered.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Won't you get hit by a stone thrown by a demon with its horn cut off? Aren't sparrows chasing me and blocking my way? Won't the dogs that only have bones come and bite them? .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I followed along for no reason. Just waiting. The problem is his curiosity. ah! It's Elliot. Elliot!
(Tipeta smiles brightly when she sees Elliot below.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliot, your sister is here. You waited, right? Hehe, you won't be able to see me anyway. Oh, there's a warrior here too.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliot, now I'm going back to Emeraldia with just the horn. So, even if you miss your sister, don’t cry. Okay?
(Elliot sticks his head out, recognizing the approaching figure of %s.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: %s, oh… Are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Elliot. Were you with me?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… . While talking with Mr. Runo... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, the horn you asked for... . Your face is pale. Where does it hurt?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s, stay right there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Runo?
(Runo, who suddenly appears, jumps up and swings the sword on his back. Then, someone who was invisible to %s a moment ago appears and counters the attack.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: How dare you cut off the hair I grew up with so much love?! You can't do that, you old deer man!!
(Luno tries to attack Tippeta again, but flies higher into the sky as if trying to attack her.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Sheesh… . Where is the cursed dragon... … .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Elliott, you. I've been watching this girl from the beginning.
(When Elliot makes eye contact with Tippeta, he is so shocked that he runs away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? I don't think I'm from the village... . Those horns, wings, and tail... .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hello, warrior. I really wanted to meet the warrior. I wanted to see you. I've waited a long time, and I'm so happy to have met you like this.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hero. I am Tippeta. Remember my name. Okay? lol.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: But what should I do? I know it took a long time to get this horn, but now it's in my hands.
(Tiphetta smiles broadly and holds up a bag containing two horn pieces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? Uh, when… .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hehe, if Yongin puts his mind to it, he can be faster than the Spirit of Light.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I'll put this horn to good use. This isn't just the ingredients to make an elixir for the heart.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: And, there's the deer guy. You thought I didn’t know, right? Take one step further this way. If you want to see Elliot die here, go for it.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ugh… . eww… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It can’t stay like this….)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Uh-huh, stop it too, hero. You don't think I'm the only one here, do you?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Do you mind if the entire village disappears? I don't want to do that either. lol.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Stay like this until I leave.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Bye then. We may never meet again, but if we do, don't forget that you will die. Okay?
(Tipetta shows a satisfied expression and flaps its wings vigorously. Then, it flies in the direction of the road and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Haha… . ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… … . I'm fine... … .
(Elliot laughs hard and then falls down)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot? Elliot!!
(Runo hurriedly checks Elliot’s condition and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Thank goodness. I just fainted for a moment. … Who would have thought that this guy who had been holding up well for a while without fainting would do this again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to tell Glinda right away.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I will do that, so follow me. I'll leave Elliot lying at home and come out, so just wait a moment in front.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… … .
(Runo looks around and looks at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Elliot, don't worry. Because I took tranquilizers and fell asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Oh, about that girl... , you said Yongin.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You don’t know about Yongin. Have you ever heard of a Draconian?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I heard it sometime ago.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It is one of the categories that humans call beastmen. They call them dragons or draconians.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They say there was an evil dragon among their ancestors, and when they mixed with humans, their descendants were all born like that.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Although it is similar to a beastman, its characteristic feature is that it possesses considerable supernatural strength.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It was once a large power that covered one axis of the Freios continent, but it became corrupted when it colluded with the demons.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: So, I heard that around the time of the chaotic sky, many forces united to subdue... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why did you come to town?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I don't know the details either. Why did the extinct people appear, why did they come to our village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to get my stuff right away.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s. Stop it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot was robbed of something he needed. I have to come visit you.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It's not something the customer should worry about. We'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still… .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'll say it again. Dorothy's village affairs will be handled by the villagers. You have come at the request of the goddess to rest quietly.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: This is the end of my request. Now it's a warning. If the boss himself steps forward... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I hope that doesn't happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think I'll get any answer right now... Let's talk later. I don't know if it's possible...)
(Runo gives up the conversation, looks at Adventurer walking away, and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: First of all, I have no choice but to do as the boss wants... .
